incident-bot: 🔔 Pager fired: region=apac service=inference metric=p99_latency threshold=4.0s value=5.6s
marta: acked pagerduty INC-2142, investigating
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-2142 created and assigned to marta
marta: seeing spikes on tokenizer stage, tokenization_time p99 ~600ms per request, coincides with recent redwood-large-v2 rollout — looks like KV-cache miss pressure
dan: confirming, logs show tokenizer worker queue depth rising, KV miss rate jumped ~80% since 03:12 UTC
marta: quick mitigation plan: (1) route APAC traffic to redwood-small-v1, (2) disable cross-request batching for APAC, (3) warm kv-cache for small model
marta: running smoke test: ```curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD' -d '{"model":"redwood-small-v1","input":"tokenize test"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate```
dan: kicked off cache-warm script (100 warmup requests to /warmup endpoint) and scaled small-model pool +2 replicas
sre-ops: applied temporary throttling to large-model pool to reduce pressure on tokenizer workers, also increased tokenization worker concurrency by 1
marta: after reroute+warmup p99 dropped to ~2.3s for APAC, overall request success rate unchanged — no 5xx seen :thumbsup:
marta: initial customer-impact assessment: small % of APAC requests experienced high tail latency for ~12m during rollout, no data loss, customers likely saw slower responses only
leo: noted. please keep PD quiet if we remain stable, otherwise escalate per runbook
marta: creating a post-incident ticket with hypothesis: tokenizer GC spikes + cold KV-cache following large-model rollout; recommend adding warmup and conservative tokenizer concurrency limits to rollout policy
leo: I'll take oncall handoff in 30m. Handoff checklist: [1] keep APAC reroute active, [2] monitor p99 and tokenization queue every 5m, [3] if p99 > 3.5s revert rollout or scale small model more, [4] follow up on rollout warmup automation
marta: handing off to @leo — leaving notes in INC-2142 and ticket RED-4372
leo: ack, monitoring. will post updates every 15m and close INC when stable for 30m
incident-bot: Pager INC-2142 marked resolved by marta — incident lifecycle: fired -> acknowledged -> mitigated -> resolved
